mapper.sql: FROM execution_session e JOIN task t ON t.id=e.task_id AND t.user_id=e.user_id JOIN stage st ON st.id=t.stage_id AND st.user_id=e.user_id JOIN goal g ON g.id=st.goal_id AND g.user_id=e.user_id
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM identity_user WHERE id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM identity_user WHERE id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT t.id AS task_id,t.version AS task_version,t.status AS task_status, a.id AS assignment_id,w.week_start_date,d.plan_date,g.id AS goal_id,st.id AS stage_id FROM task t JOIN stage st ON st.id=t.stage_id AND st.user_id=t.user_id JOIN goal g ON g.id=st.goal_id AND g.user_id=t.user_id JOIN task_assignment a ON a.task_id=t.id AND a.user_id=t.user_id AND a.ended_at IS NULL JOIN weekly_plan w ON w.id=a.weekly_plan_id AND w.user_id=t.user_id LEFT JOIN daily_plan d ON d.id=a.daily_plan_id WHERE t.id=#{taskId} AND t.user_id=#{userId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.status<>'COMPLETED' AND st.deleted_at IS NULL AND st.status<>'COMPLETED' AND g.deleted_at IS NULL AND g.archived_at IS NULL AND g.status<>'COMPLETED' AND (t.start_date IS NULL OR t.start_date<=#{today}) AND (g.start_date IS NULL OR g.start_date<=#{today}) AND w.deleted_at IS NULL AND w.week_start_date=#{today}::date-(EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM #{today}::date)::integer-1) AND (a.daily_plan_id IS NULL OR (d.id IS NOT NULL AND d.user_id=t.user_id AND d.weekly_plan_id=w.id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.plan_date=#{today}))

mapper.select: SELECT FROM execution_session e WHERE e.user_id=#{userId} AND e.id=#{id}
SELECT FROM execution_session e WHERE e.user_id=#{userId} AND e.status='RUNNING'
SELECT FROM execution_session e WHERE e.user_id=#{userId} AND e.task_id=#{taskId} AND e.status IN ('RUNNING','PAUSED')

sql.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM execution_segment s WHERE s.execution_id=e.id AND s.started_at<#{ctx.rangeEnd} AND >#{ctx.rangeStart})

mapper.sql: e.id::text AS id,e.task_id::text AS task_id,t.name AS task_name,e.status,e.started_at,e.finished_at, e.finish_reason,e.version,t.version AS task_version, floor(COALESCE(duration.total_seconds,0))::bigint AS actual_seconds, CASE WHEN #{ctx.rangeStart}::timestamptz IS NULL THEN NULL::bigint ELSE floor(COALESCE(duration.range_seconds,0))::bigint END AS range_actual_seconds, e.last_heartbeat_at,os.id::text AS active_segment_id,os.started_at AS active_segment_started_at, #{ctx.now}::timestamptz AS server_now, e.last_heartbeat_at+make_interval(secs => os.heartbeat_timeout_seconds) AS heartbeat_deadline, os.eligible_until, COALESCE(e.status='RUNNING' AND e.controller_session_id=#{ctx.sessionId} AND os.id IS NOT NULL AND LEAST(os.eligible_until,e.last_heartbeat_at+make_interval(secs => os.heartbeat_timeout_seconds))>#{ctx.now},false) AS can_heartbeat, #{ctx.heartbeatIntervalSeconds}::integer AS heartbeat_interval_seconds

LEFT JOIN execution_segment os ON os.execution_id=e.id AND os.ended_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM -s.started_at)) AS total_seconds, SUM(GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM LEAST(,#{ctx.rangeEnd}::timestamptz) -GREATEST(s.started_at,#{ctx.rangeStart}::timestamptz)),0)) AS range_seconds FROM execution_segment s WHERE s.execution_id=e.id ) duration ON true
mapper.select: WITH scoped_session AS ( SELECT e.id,e.status,e.last_heartbeat_at WHERE ), effective_segment AS ( SELECT e.id AS execution_id,s.started_at, AS effective_end FROM scoped_session e JOIN execution_segment s ON s.execution_id=e.id ), per_session AS ( SELECT e.id,e.status, COALESCE(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.effective_end-s.started_at)),0) AS total_seconds, COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM LEAST(s.effective_end,#{ctx.rangeEnd}::timestamptz) -GREATEST(s.started_at,#{ctx.rangeStart}::timestamptz)),0)) FILTER (WHERE s.execution_id IS NOT NULL),0) AS range_seconds, COALESCE(bool_or(s.started_at<#{ctx.rangeEnd} AND s.effective_end>#{ctx.rangeStart}),false) AS in_range, MAX(s.started_at) AS latest_execution_at FROM scoped_session e LEFT JOIN effective_segment s ON s.execution_id=e.id GROUP BY e.id,e.status ) SELECT COALESCE(floor(SUM(total_seconds)),0)::bigint AS total_actual_seconds, COALESCE(floor(SUM(range_seconds)),0)::bigint AS range_actual_seconds, count(*) AS total_sessions,count(*) FILTER (WHERE in_range) AS range_sessions, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='FINISHED') AS finished_sessions, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='RUNNING') AS running_sessions, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='PAUSED') AS paused_sessions, MAX(latest_execution_at) AS latest_execution_at FROM per_session
